hook: 'I can tell you wrote this yourself.'
hookText: I can tell you wrote this yourself

beats.say: That's what an honours student's project supervisor said about a ten-page midway progress report on controlling flapping-wing micro aerial vehicles. A compliment, or an insult?
The student had set the deadline a week early by accident, then spent forty-eight stressed hours writing five thousand words, references and diagrams.
The takeaway: write it yourself, and treat everything you consume like the school English lesson on spotting persuasive techniques.
